newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Min Xin keeps rising on spinoff talk.
newsitem.headline: Min Xin keeps rising on spinoff talk.

text.p: Shares of financial concern Min Xin Holdings Ltd surged on Wednesday on continued speculation the company will spin off its 36.75 percent owned Xiamen International Bank in Hong Kong, brokers said.
Min Xin rose HK$0.30, or 14.63 percent, to hit a 52-week high of HK$2.35 before steadying at HK$2.25 at midday.
The share has been rising since late August on hopes of a spin off, brokers said.
"Speculation of possible exceptional gain from the listing and stronger financial strength continues to fuel demand," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
The stock rose 20.59 percent over the prior two trading sessions.
Min Xin said last week it was seeking China's approval for a listing of the bank in Hong Kong. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
